notes: RBox revision of the topic's subproperty (RBOX_PER_TOPIC: subproperty). This record used to remove the symmetry of 'lives in mutualism with'; that edit was replaced because all four models answered no to its direct question ('Is the relation lives in mutualism with symmetric?', original yes), so they did not hold the property, reviewers flagged that mutualism is reciprocal by meaning, and the topic already changes symmetry in 0012 (asymmetric to symmetric), leaving subproperty uncovered. lobe_of is catalogued with subproperty:part_of. The edit removes the subproperty axiom, so 'X is a lobe of Y' no longer licenses 'X is part of Y'; the instance questions ask whether that follows. The caudate lobe (liver) and the flocculonodular lobe (cerebellum) are real lobes; the conclusion sentences 'caudate lobe is part of the liver' and 'flocculonodular lobe is part of the cerebellum' have no exact hits in Dolma. A model still knows from anatomy that a lobe lies inside its organ, so a stored meaning of 'lobe' competes with the edit here as in every subproperty edit; that is the point of the test, not a confound we can remove. The direct question spells out what the subproperty means, as geography-replace-0012 does. Near unrelated asks the same property of another part-like relation ('is a chamber of', still a subproperty: a leak turns yes to no); far asks a different property of an unrelated relation.
